description: BIO334 course data files for exercises

files.description: 4 sequences (~51bp each) with scattered SNPs for Day 1 exercises
2 sequences (20bp each) for Day 1 Part 2 pairwise comparison
4 sequences (10bp each) with known pi for verification. Pairwise diffs: (1,2)=1, (1,3)=1, (1,4)=0, (2,3)=2, (2,4)=1, (3,4)=1. Sum=6, pairs=6, avg=1.0. Expected pi = 1.0/10 = 0.1
AT2G19110 (HMA4) reference sequence from A. kamchatica, used with VCF files in final exam exercises
A. kamchatica halleri-origin homoeolog alignment for gene AT2G19010 (20 accessions)
A. kamchatica halleri-origin homoeolog alignment for gene AT2G19150 (20 accessions)
VCF file for accession kamMAG, halleri-origin SNPs relative to AT2G19110 reference
VCF file for accession kamALK, halleri-origin SNPs relative to AT2G19110 reference
VCF file for accession kamMAG, lyrata-origin SNPs relative to AT2G19110 reference
VCF file for accession kamALK, lyrata-origin SNPs relative to AT2G19110 reference
